verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at auth0.com/llms.txt and Markdown versions of the docs pages, which carry an index pointing agents back to llms.txt. Auth0 also publishes llms-full.txt files for docs, changelog and case studies, plus .md versions of its feature pages and an agent-experience page offering Agent Skills. missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents successfully consuming these docs, and detail on what the Agent Skills contain.
